statusDetail: Coverage-complete remote audit. No source was supplied; no fixes were applied.

page.notes: Public adult-video directory. Artifacts contain explicit imagery. Six representative paths cover home, dense listing, search, detail playback, stateful history and failure recovery. Not covered: account/auth, upload, checkout, locale-specific hosts, or exhaustive media playback.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshots plus computed CSS under default and dark preference
checkOutcomes.evidence: Default and dark captures are identical and no preference-aware color CSS is present
The reduced-motion media query matched and document.getAnimations() returned no active animations; there is no non-essential motion to suppress
Text, links, controls and thumbnails remain visible with clear system-colour outlines under forced colors
No view-transition declarations were found and navigation uses full-document route swaps
No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal animation, carousel motion or other scroll-linked motion exists to implement
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal animation, carousel motion or other scroll-linked motion exists to implement

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited templates expose links, form submission and native scrolling but no custom swipe, pull, drag or gesture-driven interaction
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates expose links, form submission and native scrolling but no custom swipe, pull, drag or gesture-driven interaction

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page layout metrics and CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long listings reach 32,294 CSS px but chrome is static and no scroll-state/progress affordance is present
No tooltip, contextual popover or anchored menu was present on the exercised states
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, contextual popover or anchored menu was present on the exercised states

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route screenshots and heading/nav inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search and detail routes place a prominent page heading before primary content and Best Of visibly marks its active section
No full-viewport popup, consent wall or obscuring interstitial appeared on load
No active modal/disclosure overlay was present; inspected controls use anchors, buttons and native form elements rather than an ad-hoc modal
Home, search and detail surfaces devote most of the viewport to category, result or media content rather than application framing

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshots and layout metrics across templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home reflows at 360px, but Best Of measures 989px scroll width and 629px overflow

checkOutcomes.method: CSS signal probe and cross-template screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container query support was found and repeated cards adapt inconsistently by template

checkOutcomes.method: Focus and target-size probe plus Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus is visible, but many targets are materially below 44x44 and Lighthouse target-size fails
Home, search and detail views clearly identify browsing, results and playback as their primary purpose

checkOutcomes.method: Manual browse flow from category to search results to detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: A homepage category leads to a populated search listing and a result opens a playable detail page with visible player controls
History remains loading without recovery and an invalid route silently becomes the homepage
Lighthouse LCP is 4.79s (poor), despite a separate trace at 1.86s; lab variability does not establish consistently good LCP

checkOutcomes.method: Layout shift observer and Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both the mobile layout observer and Lighthouse report CLS 0 with no observed shifts
The trace reports 0 long tasks and 0ms TBT; Lighthouse TBT is 44.5ms

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, DOM and Lighthouse insights
checkOutcomes.evidence: Blocking candidates, redirects, weak image caching and failed cache/dependency/render-blocking insights show inefficient delivery

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code diagnostics and HAR byte totals
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unused CSS/JS and legacy JavaScript insights fail; scripts transfer 462,676 bytes

checkOutcomes.method: Images audit, accessibility probe and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Most images and thumbnail links lack names and the search field has no label
Lighthouse reported no color-contrast failure and forced colors preserves readable text and controls
No main landmark is present and heading structure is inconsistent, though keyboard focus is visibly outlined

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshots and computed target/text inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Keyword/footer copy and metadata are small, dense and sometimes clipped

checkOutcomes.method: Narrow layout, target-size audit and detail media DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: Best Of does not reflow, targets fail sizing, and the representative video has no caption track
CORS, missing dependency, malformed JSON and failed footer errors are logged
Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but all inspected images lack explicit dimensions and Lighthouse reports unsized images
Inspector issues and legacy JavaScript are reported alongside broken resource delivery

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probes on home and search
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both templates expose unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, robots and DOM links
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scores 1.0, viewport meta exists, internal links use href and robots allows general search indexing
Canonical is absent and hreflang variants all resolve to the same English homepage
The homepage includes WebSite JSON-LD whose name and description correspond to the visible site; no contradictory entity data was observed
HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP/nosniff are absent and cookie flags are weak
Third parties account for 50/53 requests and 1.18MB, with multiple analytics/ad networks and third-party cookies
No permission prompt fired on load; the public browsing flow does not require authentication, so passkeys are not relevant to the exercised task
Clickjacking, CSP, referrer, permissions and nosniff defenses are missing

checkOutcomes.method: No-JS raw/rendered comparison on three templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage raw HTML covers only 19% of rendered words, unlike Best Of 96% and search 100%
Home, search and detail content render without blank shells, and no overlay clipping or lost navigation state was observed
This is an intrinsically network-dependent streaming content MPA; offline playback/installability is not required for the audited core task
checkOutcomes.reason: This is an intrinsically network-dependent streaming content MPA; offline playback/installability is not required for the audited core task

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid-route and asynchronous History state exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: Invalid URLs silently redirect and History has an unbounded loading state without retry

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language/hreflang and CSS logical-property probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang is always en, logical properties are absent, and multiple claimed locales point to the same English page
Month/year and count formatting remain English-style despite advertised locale variants
The audited browsing flow exposes media durations but no scheduled events, local wall times, recurring events or stored time-zone-sensitive data
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browsing flow exposes media durations but no scheduled events, local wall times, recurring events or stored time-zone-sensitive data

checkOutcomes.evidence: No confirmshaming, forced continuity, disguised checkout or obstructive cancellation was observed in the public flow
The only form is optional search with no invalid/required state; there is no user-correctable validation error to exercise
checkOutcomes.reason: The only form is optional search with no invalid/required state; there is no user-correctable validation error to exercise

checkOutcomes.evidence: The search field is unlabeled and has no autocomplete semantics
No checkout, subscription, authentication or account-management flow was part of the public representative task set
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, authentication or account-management flow was part of the public representative task set

checkOutcomes.evidence: Legacy, oversized, non-responsive and non-lazy images create avoidable transfer cost

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code diagnostics, HAR and tracker inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unused bundles and eager tracking/advertising do avoidable work before interaction
Third parties contribute 97% of initial transferred bytes and dominate slow requests

checkOutcomes.method: Robots content signals and capability probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site explicitly disallows major AI crawlers and ai-train use, indicating no intent to expose agent-facing capabilities
checkOutcomes.reason: The site explicitly disallows major AI crawlers and ai-train use, indicating no intent to expose agent-facing capabilities

checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task in the audited streaming/browsing flow requires on-device language-model or summarisation support
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the audited streaming/browsing flow requires on-device language-model or summarisation support

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline and post-10x menu-toggle heap summaries
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten open/escape cycles, self size rose only 144,147 bytes (0.27%) and node count 1,482 (0.43%), with no unbounded pattern established

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary and runtime memory metric
checkOutcomes.evidence: The content-rich page retains about 52.8MB self size and 341k heap nodes; this is proportionate to 161 images and hundreds of links in the rendered document
The summary exposes no growing Detached* constructor population, and closures rise only 37 across the 10-cycle interaction

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to the site’s declared or observed purpose.

paths.description: Homepage and category directory; global chrome, preferences, accessibility, performance, privacy and mobile layout.
Best Of listing template and pagination; selected to represent dense multi-column listings.
Search results template and primary discovery journey.
Representative media detail/playback page reached from a search result.
Stateful History surface, selected to inspect loading/empty/recovery behavior.
Deliberately invalid route to inspect HTTP/not-found recovery.

findings.summary: The interface has no user-preference-driven colour scheme.
findings.evidence: The default and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are pixel-identical, while the computed CSS probe reports no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so the already-dark palette has an intentional preference-aware counterpart.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition declarations across home, listing, search and detail routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not respond to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no scroll-state, scroll-timeline or position-aware header treatment on pages as long as 32,294 CSS px.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the compact header react to scroll state and provide position/progress feedback on very long listings.

findings.summary: The Best Of listing forces a desktop-width layout on mobile.
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 viewport, layout measured scrollWidth 989px and 629px horizontal overflow; the mobile screenshot clips navigation and pagination.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the desktop viewport/layout override, use intrinsic grids, and verify every template at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Repeated cards do not use container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container/container-type rules, and card/list layouts vary inconsistently between home, Best Of and search templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card regions containment and adapt card typography/actions with container queries.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too small for touch.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe found header controls at 38x34px, promotional links at 24px high, and many category links only 14-15px high; Lighthouse target-size failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes to at least 44x44 CSS px while preserving the visible focus outline and non-hover labels.

findings.summary: History and invalid-route states do not provide useful recovery.
findings.evidence: The History screenshot remains on “Loading…” without timeout or action, while a deliberately invalid URL silently redirects to the homepage with no not-found explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add bounded loading, empty/error messaging and retry/clear actions; return a real 404 page with recovery links.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.79s, FCP 2.83s and Speed Index 4.50s; the independent trace measured LCP 1.86s, showing variable network-sensitive performance.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail/logo, shorten render-blocking chains, and defer analytics/advertising until after primary content.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is slowed by blocking and poorly cached resources.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 53 requests/1.21MB, multiple parser-inserted styles/scripts, 6 redirects, and many images without cache headers; Lighthouse cache, LCP discovery, dependency-tree and render-blocking insights failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, preload only the LCP resource, set durable immutable cache headers for versioned assets, and remove redirect chains.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and legacy JavaScript/CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed unused-css, unused-javascript and legacy-javascript insights; scripts account for 462,676 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template, remove redundant libraries and serve a modern baseline bundle.

findings.summary: Core browsing links, thumbnails and search lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: The probe found 160 of 161 images without meaningful alt and an unlabeled search input; Lighthouse link-name failed on thumbnail links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each thumbnail link one descriptive accessible name, meaningful image alt where needed, and an explicit search label.

findings.summary: The document lacks a main landmark and has weak heading structure.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported no main landmark; the probe found only one landmark, and the Best Of page rendered no h1 while the search page used three h1 elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and use one page h1 followed by a logical heading hierarchy.

findings.summary: Some text is cramped and difficult to scan.
findings.evidence: The History screenshot shows a dense, centered keyword block at small size, and listing metadata commonly renders at 12-15px with clipped titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase body/metadata sizing and line-height, constrain line length, and use balanced wrapping for headings.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The Best Of template overflows by 629px at 360px, Lighthouse target-size failed, and the representative detail video exposes no track elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix reflow and target sizing, and provide captions/transcripts for video content.

findings.summary: Production pages emit repeated runtime and network errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured CORS failures, require-is-not-defined, malformed JSON, failed footer loading and related console/network errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct CDN CORS/resource URLs, guarantee dependency order, validate JSON responses and remove noisy production console errors.

findings.summary: Image assets are structurally unsized and inefficiently encoded.
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 100 inspected images lacked width/height, 12 were oversized, 100 used legacy formats and 99 lacked alt; Lighthouse unsized-images failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, responsive srcset/sizes and modern formats from the image pipeline.

findings.summary: Inspector and delivery hygiene issues remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse inspector-issues failed alongside broken CORS-loaded scripts and legacy-javascript diagnostics.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools inspector issues, stale/legacy dependencies and broken asset delivery before release.

findings.summary: Canonical/indexing signals are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The homepage and search metadata probes exposed no canonical URL, while hreflang entries for six locales all point to the same English homepage; robots and sitemap otherwise return 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referencing canonicals and only emit hreflang variants that return correctly localized equivalents.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but application defenses and cookie flags are weak.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP or nosniff; the cookie audit found four cookies without Secure and all eight using SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, and Secure plus Lax/Strict cookie defaults unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The page sends a large tracking and advertising footprint before interaction.
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes 50 of 53 requests and 1.18MB of 1.21MB to third-party origins; trackers include Google Analytics plus Yandex and ad networks, with 27 third-party cookies in Lighthouse.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential tracking on informed consent, batch analytics, and load ads/analytics after core content.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are mostly absent.
findings.evidence: Headers lack CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; only HSTS is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, nosniff and an enforceable CSP; evaluate Trusted Types for script-heavy surfaces.

findings.summary: The homepage exposes only a small share of rendered content without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 19% homepage word coverage without JS, compared with 96% for Best Of and 100% for search.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the complete primary category/navigation content and enhance it with JavaScript rather than injecting core links client-side.

findings.summary: Failure states are replaced by silent redirects or indefinite loading.
findings.evidence: The invalid path returned the homepage URL/content instead of a 404 state, while History stayed on an indefinite loading indicator with no retry.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct HTTP error pages and add timeout, retry, offline and empty-state handling to asynchronous views.

findings.summary: Declared language variants are not reflected in document language or layout readiness.
findings.evidence: The page declares html lang=en and no logical-property CSS, yet displays Hindi text and advertises be, ru, ar, en-in and hi hreflang URLs all pointing to the English homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve genuinely localized pages with correct lang/dir and use logical properties so RTL and translated copy reflow safely.

findings.summary: Counts and month/year labels appear hard-coded to one locale.
findings.evidence: The Best Of view renders “June 2026” and comma-grouped counts while the site advertises multiple locales; no locale-aware variation was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Format month/year, counts and durations through Intl for the active locale.

findings.summary: The search input is unlabeled and provides no autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports the text input named k has no label and an empty autocomplete attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible label and autocomplete/search semantics without preventing paste or browser assistance.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery wastes bandwidth and omits responsive formats.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 100 legacy-format images, 12 oversized assets, 13 without srcset and 89 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, fixed dimensions and native lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Unused code and pre-interaction tracking consume avoidable resources.
findings.evidence: Unused CSS/JS and legacy bundle insights failed while analytics and advertising account for several scripts and background requests before user action.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused bundles and defer/background-prioritise optional analytics and advertising work.

findings.summary: Third parties dominate the initial page budget.
findings.evidence: Third parties transferred 1,178,396 of 1,211,998 bytes; GTM alone was 166KB and the slowest request at 1.84s.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove duplicate analytics, defer advertising, and lazy-load media only when it approaches the viewport.

taskList.title: Minimise and consent-gate third-party tracking and advertising
Restore accessible names, landmarks, captions and target sizing
Add CSP and complete the defensive header/cookie baseline
Fix mobile reflow on Best Of and adopt component-aware cards
Optimise responsive images and critical resource delivery
Fix production JavaScript/CORS errors and remove unused code
Implement explicit loading, 404, timeout and retry recovery
Correct canonical, hreflang and locale-aware rendering
Add preference-aware theming and navigation transitions
